source: MLB Stats API, Baseball Savant, MLB Film Room, MLB.com (tools/mlb-plays)

bases_empty.label: Bases empty
bases_empty.rule: No runner on base before the play

risp.label: Runner in scoring position
risp.rule: Runner on second or third before the play

force_available.label: Force play available
force_available.rule: Runner on first (every runner behind an open base is forced on a ground ball)

dp_situation.label: Double-play situation
dp_situation.rule: Runner on first and fewer than two outs

leading.label: Batting team leading
leading.rule: Batting team ahead before the play

trailing.label: Batting team trailing
trailing.rule: Batting team behind before the play

one_run.label: One-run game
one_run.rule: Score separated by exactly one run

blowout.label: Blowout (5+ runs)
blowout.rule: Score separated by five or more runs

tying_run_on.label: Tying run on base
tying_run_on.rule: Batting team trails and the tying run is on base

go_ahead_on.label: Go-ahead run on base
go_ahead_on.rule: The run that would put the batting team ahead is on base

walkoff_situation.label: Walk-off situation
walkoff_situation.rule: Bottom of the 9th or later, home team not ahead

winning_run_on.label: Potential winning run on base
winning_run_on.rule: Walk-off situation with the winning run on base

high_leverage.label: High leverage (LI ≥ 2)
high_leverage.rule: MLB leverage index of the plate appearance ≥ 2.0

low_leverage.label: Low leverage (LI < 0.85)
low_leverage.rule: MLB leverage index of the plate appearance < 0.85

walk.label: Walk
walk.rule: Official event: walk or intentional walk

two_out_rbi.label: Two-out RBI
two_out_rbi.rule: Run(s) batted in with two outs

productive_out.label: Productive out
productive_out.rule: An out on which a runner advanced or scored (not a double play)

runner_scored_on_out.label: Run scored on an out
runner_scored_on_out.rule: A run scored on a play that recorded an out

go_ahead_play.label: Go-ahead play
go_ahead_play.rule: Batting team went from tied or behind to ahead on the play

walkoff.label: Walk-off
walkoff.rule: The play ended the game with the home team winning

caught_stealing.label: Caught stealing
caught_stealing.rule: Official caught stealing (incl. pickoff caught stealing)

pickoff.label: Pickoff
pickoff.rule: Pickoff or pickoff attempt recorded as an out

first_to_third.label: First to third on a single
first_to_third.rule: Runner went from first to third on a single

score_from_second_single.label: Scored from second on a single
score_from_second_single.rule: Runner scored from second on a single

score_from_first_xbh.label: Scored from first on extra-base hit
score_from_first_xbh.rule: Runner scored from first on a double or triple

tag_up.label: Tag-up advance
tag_up.rule: Runner advanced on a caught fly or line drive

rundown.label: Rundown
rundown.rule: Runner put out after four or more fielder touches, or one fielder touching the ball twice (official credits)

runner_out_on_bases.label: Runner out on the bases
runner_out_on_bases.rule: A runner (not the batter) put out while advancing or returning — not a force, steal or pickoff (objective proxy for baserunning mistakes)

doubled_off.label: Doubled off
doubled_off.rule: Runner doubled off on a caught ball

wild_pitch.label: Wild pitch
wild_pitch.rule: Runner(s) advanced on a wild pitch

passed_ball.label: Passed ball
passed_ball.rule: Runner(s) advanced on a passed ball

double_play.label: Double play
double_play.rule: Two outs recorded on the play

force_play.label: Force play
force_play.rule: A runner put out on a force

tag_play.label: Tag play on a runner
tag_play.rule: A runner (not the batter) tagged or thrown out at a base, not a force

outfield_assist.label: Outfield assist
outfield_assist.rule: An outfielder credited with an assist on an out

relay.label: Relay / cutoff throw
relay.rule: Out completed through an outfielder and a relay infielder (credits OF → IF → putout)

out_at_plate.label: Out at the plate
out_at_plate.rule: A runner put out at home plate

play_at_plate.label: Play at the plate
play_at_plate.rule: Runner put out at home, or the catcher credited on a scoring play

error.label: Defensive error
error.rule: An error credited on the play

ground_ball_infield.label: Ground ball to the infield
ground_ball_infield.rule: Ground ball fielded by an infielder

middle_infield.label: Ball to the middle infield
middle_infield.rule: Ball fielded first by the second baseman or shortstop

outfield_play.label: Ball to the outfield
outfield_play.rule: Ball fielded first by an outfielder

catcher_throw.label: Catcher throw-out
catcher_throw.rule: Caught stealing or pickoff with the catcher credited

catcher_play.label: Catcher involved
catcher_play.rule: Catcher credited with a putout or assist on a non-strikeout play

bunt_defense_pc.label: Bunt fielded by pitcher or catcher
bunt_defense_pc.rule: Bunt first fielded by the pitcher or catcher

shift_alignment.label: Non-standard infield alignment
shift_alignment.rule: Statcast infield alignment other than Standard

of_alignment_nonstd.label: Non-standard outfield alignment
of_alignment_nonstd.rule: Statcast outfield alignment other than Standard

challenge.label: Reviewed / challenged
challenge.rule: The play had a replay review
